Done. Here's what was created:

**ShipmentTracker** — a Blazor Web App in `/tmp/sv-484ce8112d234a3993c7377733a75f74/ShipmentTracker/`

**Architecture choices:**
| Requirement | Solution |
|---|---|
| Fast first load | Server-side prerendering |
| Snappy after load | **Auto** render mode (starts Server, switches to WebAssembly) |
| Global users, low latency | WebAssembly runs locally after download — no server round-trips |
| Every page interactive | All pages use `@rendermode InteractiveAuto` |
| Individual accounts | ASP.NET Core Identity with Dispatcher/Customer roles |

**Key pages:**
- `/` — Home with links and demo credentials
- `/track` — Public shipment tracking by tracking number
- `/shipments` — Authenticated list (dispatchers see all, customers see theirs) with filter/status controls
- `/shipments/new` — Dispatcher-only shipment creation form

**Demo accounts:**
- **Dispatcher:** `dispatcher@shiptracker.com` / `Dispatch1!`
- **Customer:** `customer@example.com` / `Customer1!`

Run with: `cd ShipmentTracker && dotnet run --project ShipmentTracker`
